serve_text_generation_model: run the text generation inference server with a specified model id and optional quantization settings
download_model_weights: download model weights from the huggingface hub for a given model id and revision
quantize_model_gptq: quantize a model using GPTQ 4-bit quantization and save the output to a directory
review_serve_command: review the serve command to understand sharded deployment and LoRA adapter configuration options
review_quantization_enums: review the Quantization, Dtype, and KVCacheDtype enums to understand supported quantization and precision options
